story.body: A-Step is a platform dedicated to helping Algerian youth—whether students or recent graduates—explore and bring them closer to their global opportunities. Whether you need tailored one-to-one consultations or free comprehensive guides and trackers to navigate on your own, A-Step equips you with everything required to succeed.

about.metaDescription: Why A-Step exists and how we help Algerian students make informed international decisions.
about.title: Guidance that respects your ambition and your reality
about.intro: A-Step is an independent Algerian education and immigration guidance platform. We help students and recent graduates understand their options and prepare with confidence.
about.storyBody: An application decision can shape years of your life. Advice should be current, transparent and specific enough to act on. A-Step makes complicated procedures easier to understand without making promises nobody can honestly guarantee.
about.whoBody: Students and recent graduates in Algeria who are exploring international study, scholarships, visas and structured immigration routes.

agency.a: No. A-Step is an independent guidance platform. We help you understand options, documents and processes; we do not act as a university, embassy or government office.

located.a: A-Step is based in Algeria and serves students primarily online, which makes support accessible regardless of your wilaya.

guarantee.q: Does A-Step guarantee admission or a visa?
guarantee.a: No. No legitimate adviser can guarantee a university admission or visa decision. Those decisions belong entirely to institutions and public authorities.

payments.a: Any paid service, its scope and its price are explained before you agree. Payment instructions are shared directly and a record is provided.

complaint.q: What if I have a problem or complaint?
complaint.a: Contact us by email or WhatsApp with the details. We aim to acknowledge complaints promptly and work toward a clear resolution.

languages.q: What languages do you offer support in?
languages.a: Support and website resources are available in English, French and Arabic.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.introBody: When you request a guide, subscribe or contact us, we collect the details you submit: your name, email address and message. Our server may retain a salted hash of your IP address for abuse prevention; we do not store your raw IP for this purpose.
privacy.useBody: We use this information to deliver requested resources, answer messages, manage subscriptions and protect forms from abuse. We do not sell personal information.
privacy.storageBody: Data is securely processed and stored on A-Step cloud infrastructure. Access to leads and messages is restricted to authorized A-Step administrators.
privacy.rightsBody: You may unsubscribe from marketing messages at any time. To request access, correction or deletion of your information, email belabbesbadibac@gmail.com.
privacy.cookiesBody: The site does not set advertising cookies. If privacy-friendly analytics is configured, it is used only to understand aggregate site usage without building advertising profiles.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.scopeBody: A-Step provides educational information and personal guidance. It is not a university, embassy, immigration authority or legal practice.
terms.guaranteeBody: Admissions, scholarships and visa outcomes are decided by independent institutions and authorities. A-Step cannot and does not guarantee an outcome.
terms.accuracyBody: We work to keep information current, but requirements can change. You remain responsible for checking official sources and submitting accurate documents before the applicable deadline.
terms.conductBody: Do not misuse forms, attempt unauthorized access, redistribute paid materials without permission or use the site in a way that disrupts service for others.
terms.contactBody: For questions about these terms, contact belabbesbadibac@gmail.com.
